meta.title: Flower garden
meta.description: Adds a garden session tab with four grounds and twenty-five flowers, each with a stable individual appearance. Grow flowers, greet pollinators, breed hybrids and discover eight curiosities. Sell blooms, fill ordinary bouquet orders or enter themed shows every six hours. Soil, crop rotation, compost and market saturation encourage varied play; coins and show ribbons upgrade hives, greenhouses and breeding benches. Specimen dialogs include botanical facts, and sixteen achievements track progress. Saved locally in this browser across sessions; no model requests, tools or network access.
